product_desc: raw cubed beef flank, deep red with white fat marbling, as sold in a supermarket tray
cook: a home cook in their late thirties, dark hair tied back, plain shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearm under a dark apron
kitchen: a warm renovated Chinese home kitchen with warm wood cabinets, light tile backsplash, gas stove, heavy braising pot, warm window light from the left, and a wooden prep counter
prep_subject: ripe tomatoes cut into large wedges beside raw beef flank cubes on a white ceramic plate, with thin ginger slices, cut spring onion and two star anise. It defines the cut sizes for the whole ad
prep_defines: the large tomato wedge size, beef cube size, ginger slices, spring onion and star anise
cook_vessel: a heavy braising pot over a low blue gas flame
cook_subject: beef cubes and tomato wedges cooking in a thick glossy red-orange sauce in the braising pot over a low blue flame, tomatoes partly collapsed, sauce clinging rather than watery
cook_negatives: canned tomatoes, tomato paste, ketchup colour, thin watery soup, western beef stew with carrots and potatoes, curry, burnt or separated sauce, raw grey beef
hero_subject: the finished dish in a wide shallow ceramic bowl, tender beef cubes coated in thick glossy red-orange tomato sauce, spring onion scattered on top, a bowl of steamed white rice behind
hero_setting: a warm home dining table in the same renovated Chinese home kitchen, a bowl of steamed white rice slightly out of focus behind
story: beef cubes sear in the braising pot
fresh tomato wedges collapse into a glossy sauce
braised beef lands in the bowl with spring onion
negatives_global: canned tomatoes, tomato paste, ketchup colour, western beef stew with carrots and potatoes, curry, minced beef, thin watery sauce, dry meat, oily separated sauce, plastic packaging, sealed tray, product label, printed nutrition panel, barcode
first_heat: The beef immediately begins to sear, its edges turning from deep red to brown, and steam lifts from the contact.
clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at pot rim, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The braising pot of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame over a blue gas flame, the beef cubes now browned on all sides and glistening. The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the board of tomato wedges from <Picture 3>, tip it once over the pot, and the wedges slide in among the beef. The hands withdraw straight up out of frame with the empty board. The tomatoes settle against the hot beef and their cut faces immediately begin to soften and glisten. The camera does not move at any point in this shot.
transform: the tomato wedges visibly collapse, their skins loosen and curl, their flesh softens into the liquid, and the juice turns deep red-orange as it reduces around the beef into a thick glossy sauce.
lift: A wooden spoon enters from the left already submerged, draws once through the sauce from left to right in one continuous pass, then lifts a single beef cube clear at the right of frame while sauce runs off it back into the pot in slow glossy threads.
plate: A large spoon enters from the left already loaded with beef cubes and collapsed tomato, crosses to the bowl in one continuous movement, tips, and the beef slides in with the thick sauce following slowly behind it.
final_lift: A pair of chopsticks enters from the right, closes on one beef cube, lifts it clear of the bowl, and holds it steady at the centre of frame while a thread of sauce runs back down.
sound_01: A quiet home kitchen with a low room tone. In the first shot, the soft slide of a ceramic plate and a wooden board across a counter. In the second shot, the light wet sound of tomato wedges being gathered and settling against each other. In the third shot, the steady low hiss of a gas burner, then a sharp rising sizzle as the beef meets hot oil, settling into a steady crackle. No speech, no music from within the room.
sound_02: A home kitchen with a low room tone. In the first shot, a steady sizzle from the pot, then the wet drop of tomato wedges landing among hot beef and the sizzle briefly dulling. In the second shot, the sizzle softening into a thick slow bubbling as the sauce reduces. In the third shot, that slow bubbling continuing beneath, the quiet drag of a wooden spoon through thick sauce, and sauce running off in heavy threads. No speech, no music from within the room.
sound_03: A quiet warm home with a low room tone. In the first shot, thick sauce and beef sliding from a spoon into a ceramic bowl, landing heavily. In the second shot, the light patter of chopped spring onion on the surface and the soft rise of steam. In the third shot, the small click of chopsticks closing, and a single thread of sauce dripping back into the bowl. No speech, no music from within the room.
music: A warm domestic bed: low strings under a slow plucked figure, unhurried and appetising rather than energetic.
